description:
An Open Source multitrack tablature editor and player written in Java.


* Add tonic note highlighting on fretboard
* Improve Guitar Pro import
* Export beat text in MusicXML
* Do not discard undo history when saving song
* Fix double-play scenario during count-in
* Fix not playing note when a note is created with keyboard
* Fix custom beat move
* Fix time signature change in free edition mode
* Move all following beats when deleting a rest in free edition mode
* Append empty measures when pasting a copied selection past the end of the song
